uncited: It separates low-frequency content from high-frequency details using inverse lifting operations, avoiding the over- and undershoots (and resulting topological changes in isosurfaces) caused by standard subdivision wavelets [B-spline Wavelet Lifting Scheme](7585-b-spline-wavelet-lifting-scheme.md).

It is distinguished from its sibling [2D B-spline Wavelet Masks (Quadtree)](7753-2d-b-spline-wavelet-masks-quadtree.md) by its specific 1D lifting formulation for linear splines, whereas the sibling addresses 2D mesh structures with arbitrary polygons.
